variants.prompt: On a sultry summer evening, Magnolia perches on the edge of a weathered wooden dock, her bare feet dangling above the water. She wears a tiny, string bikini top and a pair of high-waisted, denim cutoff shorts that leave little to the imagination. Her long, honey-blonde hair flows over her shoulders, and she looks out at the rippling lake with a faraway, contemplative expression. The golden hour casts a warm glow on her sun-kissed skin, accentuating the curves of her body as she leans forward, her elbows on her knees.
